_comment: Controlled vocabulary of skill/topic tags for readings. Tags group the landing page and README table — deliberately decoupled from module numbers, since module order/grouping can change. Add new tags here as new topics arrive; don't invent ad hoc tags in a reading.meta.json without adding them here first.

python-fundamentals.label: Python Fundamentals
python-fundamentals.description: Syntax, variables, functions, control flow, scope

debugging-testing.label: Debugging & Testing
debugging-testing.description: Tracing bugs, error handling, validation, test habits

data-serialization.label: Data Serialization & I/O
data-serialization.description: JSON/CSV, file I/O, data interchange formats

eda-statistics.description: Exploratory data analysis, distributions, statistical tests

software-practice.label: Software Engineering Practice
software-practice.description: Version control, project structure, collaboration habits
